issue_title: Resolve the writer golden-path smoke gap on the frozen build

approach.summary: Repeat the missing customer-facing writer walkthrough on the exact frozen build and retain a new artifact that either resolves the old blocked-note gap or preserves the blocker as the current retained-package note.
rationale: The analysis identified the blocked live writer smoke as the only explicitly documented unresolved customer-facing evidence gap.
This work should run only after the build identity is frozen, otherwise the smoke artifact cannot be tied back to the customer handoff package.

The smoke could only be closed with direct retained-package evidence, whether through DevTools MCP or an alternate operator-recorded walkthrough that still proved the golden path; otherwise the retained blocker had to stay explicit.
non_goals: Do not change core product behavior in this issue unless the smoke finds a blocking regression.
Do not assemble the customer handoff bundle in this issue.
risk_controls: Use the exact build artifact and SHA recorded by the frozen-baseline issue.
Retain a written operator note if tooling constraints force a manual walkthrough path.

tasks.title: Choose a non-conflicting smoke execution path
tasks.description: Resolve the previous Chrome DevTools MCP browser/profile conflict or document an alternative walkthrough method that still produces replayable smoke evidence tied to the frozen build.
acceptance: The execution path names the browser/tooling approach and the exact build to test.
The plan explicitly references the previous blocked note from `cwp-client-delivery-handoff-20260413`.

tasks.title: Run and retain the writer golden-path smoke evidence
tasks.description: Cover the customer-facing golden path on the frozen build: launch, main writing flow, Writing Helper, and the key settings/knowledge entry points, then retain screenshots, log references, or a structured operator note that truthfully marks the old gap as closed or still blocked.
acceptance: The retained smoke artifact names the tested SHA/build artifact.
The retained smoke artifact states whether the previous blocked note is now closed or remains the current blocker note.

dependencies: Requires the frozen baseline from `ISS-20260418-002` so the smoke is traceable to the frozen build.
Should cite `.workflow/.csv-wave/cwp-client-delivery-handoff-20260413/context.md` as the source of the previous blocked note.
conflict_risks: If this smoke run exposes a blocking product regression, the delivery plan must branch back into implementation rather than silently treating the note as closed.
